items.text: Hello Commandos,
Deploying hotfix 3.1 with various minor bug fixes. See the notes below for full details!
Fixed a bug where no spare parts were available in Retrieval mode for “Demon Bait”.
After reconnecting, players will no longer see the “Attack” objective marker, even though the objective has already been completed on “Demon Bait”.
The winchable door at the “Demon Bait” spawn point now always opens.
Fixed a bug where the bot takes damage from contamination after the player is disconnected following the Control Room Defenses on "Deliver Us".
The bots no longer continue to take damage from contamination sometimes after its effect ends on “Deliver Us".
Fixed a bug where the artifact may be counted as having been collected even if it did not actually get consumed before entering the Incapacitated state in Retrieval mode.
Fixed a bug where the node icon does not disappear when the node core is destroyed in Retrieval mode.
Fixed an issue where the Icon threat level is displayed as “High Threat” in some cases when the setting is “Maximum Threat” in Retrieval mode.
The Sludge Node icon no longer disappears from the map when players get close enough to this node in Retrieval mode.
The Sludge Node indicator now disappears at the end of Retrieval mode when the anti-sludge vehicle's dome activates.
Fixed a bug where the anti-sludge vehicle spawns in plain view of the player during the final phase of Retrieval mode on "High Octane".
Fixed a bug where the Goon sometimes gets stuck in the heavy hit animation when taking damage from a Saw Trap.
Fixed a bug where the blood decals sometimes disappear on the gore of Goblins.
The Seasonal Challenge is now highlighted when the player hover over it using the D-Pad.
The Trials menu now displays the correct skins of characters who are wearing DLC skins.
Fixed a bug where Astrid's default hair appeared in some headgears.
The number of seasonal challenges completed is now displayed correctly while player is on the game map.
The condition for unlocking customization items is now displayed correctly after navigating to or exiting their preview.
Fixed a bug where the player can pick up an exploded gas can from a vehicle slot.
Fixed the outline appearing on the vehicle slot when the player is holding a burning gas can.
Fixed a rare situation in which players cannot revive the teammate from the Incapacitated state.
Many stability improvements and crashes fixes.
Small localization fixes.

releases.displayName: About the items from Season 1 Challenges

items.text: Hello Commandos,

This is techinically not a hotfix but more a statement about some concerns we've read. We've seen comments about the Season 1 Challenges (Trials) and understand that some of you fear that all the rewards would never be unlockable again now that Season 2 has started with Update 3.0.

Just so you know the items from S1 are not gone forever they will be progressively put to the shop every week. The exceptions are the Titles, and the final avatar, which is the reward for completing the entire season. To be transparent, you won’t be able to purchase all items at once.
The shop will use in-game currency, which can be earned only by completing Challenges. There are no plans to make purchases with real money outside of the DLC packs. It will be updated periodically.
Focus & Saber teams
Our second big update is live! 🫡

Introducing a new game mode: Retrieval, a high-octane extraction mode. Also in this update: a new enemy, new weapons, a new movement ability, and multiple Quality of Life updates. Full patch notes below.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/5470aecc9ab274b998fc35ce0f4581c0d97d3db1.png"]

In this high-stakes mode, Leon dispatches your squad to retrieve six artifacts under the watchful glare of the Sludge God. Every time you collect an artifact, the Sludge God’s anger grows. Work together to eliminate enemies and fight your way to the extraction point before the air becomes too poisonous.
Hide from the Sludge god in safety domes to stabilize the sludge activity, slay enemies to slow down the environment corruption. Destroy the sludge nodes if the situation as a last resort.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/1a0f95676a95b47cf7d1864b4cccb57851cd3bad.png"]

The Goblins are small but mighty enemies that always appear in groups of three. They attack the same target and can revive each other if any of the three remain alive. To defeat the Goblins, players must eliminate all three creatures within a short period of time, otherwise the survivors will revive their fallen allies.
Though their force lies in their numbers, they individually pack enough power to send you flying. Coordinate your attacks to wipe them in a fell swoop!
Le Clairon: Assault bullpup rifle with 3 firing modes.
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/sedjem/2157830_20260722113558_1-2.png"]

Thunderstick: Lightning melee weapon that applies a temporary lightning effect to enemies. If charged it triggers a small explosion which knocks enemies back and deal some heavy lightning damage to up to three nearby targets. If the Thunderstick hits the ground, static lightning bolts linger in this area and damage enemies standing in it. [img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/sedjem/2157830_20260722113654_1-1.png"]
Flamethrower: Portable jet flamethrower to send the infected straight back to hell.[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/sedjem/2157830_20260722113729_1.png"]
[img src="https://medias.community.focus-entmt.com/forums/sedjem/carattachment.jpg"]
​We have overhauled the game's vehicle fleet with major upgrades, balance tweaks, and visual updates:
Added universal winch modules and unique suspension physics for each vehicle.
Adjusted HP, ground clearance and maneuverability across all vehicles to improve overall handling and performance.
Added a dynamic cargo attachment system. Players can now attach pickable items — such as gas canisters, ammo, or heavy weapons — directly to matching slots on the vehicle.
The dash quickly moves the player 3 meters on the ground or in the air and consumes stamina when activated. If used timely, the dash can save players from being grabbed by Goon, Hornet or Mace.

notes.title: There are two kinds of Dash

items.text: Angle Dash to dash diagonally or at a specific angle, but not forward
Free Dash to dash in any direction

One more defense available for Spare Parts at the end of missions. When activated, the saw trap slowly rotates and then speeds up to eliminate enemies caught in its area of ​​effect. After dealing a certain amount of damage, the saw trap stops, but can be repaired.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/f4443489474d62bf7edea4240edaeddc05d63dfb.png"]

Added multiple unique weapon skins, patterns, weapon charms, character skins, unique vehicle skin and patterns, tints, vehicle graffiti, light colors, honk sounds, vehicle display and profile customization.

Only one Sludge Seed spawns per mission. When any player grabs it, everyone on the team receives one (giving the team 4 seeds total). If any player is trapped in a cocoon without a Sludge Seed, but there is a bot with a Sludge Seed in the same cocoon, the player can command a bot to use a Sludge Seed to revive both of them.
Depending on the difficulty level bots begin the match with certain sets of perks, abilities and firearms designed for this difficulty.
Bots now gather in Healer and Tank safe domes.
Bots use heal ability for any player with HP < 70.
Challenge System Overhaul: Added new tasks, rebalanced requirements, and introduced visual progress/rewards on the post-match screen. Season 2 challenge content is now live.

A new HUD customization system has been implemented. Players can now fully customize their interface to suit their playstyle by choosing between three modes: always visible, completely hidden or dynamic.
Local server hosting, will allow players to create private games with friends on locally hosted servers.

Local hosting comes with its own set of drawbacks, it requires: stable internet connection, higher CPU and RAM load. The reason behind this is our client-server architecture. We are offloading some parts of our game logic onto the server to make it easier for people with low-end devices to enjoy our game. Hence, when a player is hosting locally, that logic and the server itself work on this player’s machine, and this player’s internet connection affects the experience of other players.

To better utilize the new feature, consider picking a friend with the best CPU and internet connection. If there are 16 GB of RAM available, one should be good only if some hungry little web app isn't chewing on memory.
Note: this is an experimental feature. So don't hesitate to provide us with your personal feedback.
Shotgun Buffs: Increased damage at a range of 4–5 meters. Reduced ADS spread for some shotguns.
Support for AZERTY and QWERTZ keyboard layouts has been implemented.
Bug fixes.
Hello Commandos,
Patch 2.4 just released, correcting various crashes and introducing a new weapon as a reward for the recently completed community event.
Correction of crashes and various bug fixes.
Thunderbolt OEP is now available for all players, since you have completed the latest Community Challenge. Congrats!
Experimental beam rifle - collects energy charges with each kill, boosting its damage output. When fully charged, a reload triggers a powerful explosion.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/529e1d342f11a717bf964ecb2a7107f06c533afd.png"]
Enjoy!

This issue happened when players last launched version 1.5 or any earlier version of the game, and quit the game without receiving or watching the post-match until the end.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Hotfix 2.2 was deployed fixing the crash at launch for Nvidia GPU's. Another hotfix resloving the post match screen bug will follow.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

releases.displayName: Content update with new mission is live!

items.text: Hello Commandos!

Big content update just dropped on John Carpenter's Toxic Commando! The sludge threat has spread deep into the city and requires you to once again go commando. A new mission enters the game: Urban Blight will take you in the heart of a mutated city.
New map doesn't come without new toys! Weapons, vehicles, skins, we've got it all covered. Be prepared to go underground activity and don't forget to watch the sky for the new Hornet ennemy!
We're also introducing challenges, QoL changes and much more. See the patch notes below.
Leon dispatches commandos to investigate a sludge leak spilling from the contaminated zone.

The trail leads to the ruins of Rockbridge, where Hopewell’s experiments have mutated the sludge into something far more dangerous. The commandos must breach the city and confront new dangers in an urban environment with highly intricate layouts. You will descend into fetid sewers, fight through hordes of enemies, and storm abandoned apartments floor by floor. To succeed, you'll need to discover powerful weapons, vehicles, and gear scattered throughout the mission.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/0aa834e635a24ae04cd51e646c042f68cd86b5ff.jpg"]

An airborne enemy that fires projectiles, the Hornet can dodge incoming attacks. When it closes in on a target, it grabs a player, flies high into the sky, and drops the victim from that deadly height. The other players must kill the Hornet before it lifts the victim too high, or the fall will be fatal.
* Added for all missions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/85dc67965ed409c962a02bb090d3de6bf3bbdad6.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/0ebb20e344b3a9412dad87235735dd605be2d93e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/962e9231f1adfc835def89e27b71b7d0b6e8c3b0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/7f115d1a24ded5ea83ea4cc47ee215ea748f93a7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/f17fa3f1822b43fd83a80a28edc642a204130fb1.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/b32b7b01ce026da9a595e0c9b248438c7a18f6d0.jpg"]

[p align="justify"]Leon’s assignments are now available in the HUB. A special terminal awaits you that issues dynamic challenges.
[p align="justify"]The challenges cover different playstyles: eliminating special targets, speed-running through zones, gathering rare resources, team-based objectives, and much more.
[p align="justify"]Completing them awards experience, which advances the overall challenge progress bar.
[p align="justify"]Rewards for your efforts: Accumulated experience unlocks access to unique rewards: rare emotes, weapon skins and trinkets to commemorate your achievements.

Hello Commandos,
We're rolling out a quick Hotfix, correcting the Prestige system. Changing the prestige level of a maxxed out weapon was made impossible following Patch 1.6.
It is now possible again to change the prestige level of your weapon once it's already maxxed out.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.
The Focus & Saber team
Hello Commandos,
Patch 1.6 is now live!

Prepare to suffer. Very few Commandos will be ready for our new difficulty setting: the INSANE one. This is the ultimate challenge, only for certified elite zombie killers. To unlock the Insane difficulty for each map, it must first be completed on Hard difficulty.

We tested this new difficulty at the beginning of April on the Public Test Server and we'd like to thank you for your feedback on it! We'll definitely be having more Public Testing sessions so be on the lookout.

Alongside the Prestige system change you've requested, we're also implementing a ton of balance changes on this patch. The Defender becomes quite a bit stronger and the Medic is a bit tuned down. More details in the patch notes below.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746769/4429d30429ed4f2fe9cfc08ec80397ec5f8eabce.png"]
Prepare to suffer! This difficulty setting is impossible to pass without a maxed-out player progression.
We added rewards for completing the game on Insane difficulty as well.

notes.title: Changes we made to the "Insane" difficulty following the Public Test Server

items.text: Slightly reduced damage dealt by Roamers on Insane difficulty
Lowered health points for Roamers on Insane difficulty
Attachments and Tiers are no longer removed when upgrading a Weapon's Prestige; only the Weapon's level is now removed when upgrading a Weapon's Prestige.
The moment the first player dies, a random Revival Pod is selected for him from those located between 100 and 160 meters away. If there are no such Revival Pods, the nearest Revival Pod is selected.
This change was made to remove situations where players had to cross a significant part of the map to rescue their teammates from the Revival Pod.
The Operator Class.
Drone: Base damage increased by 20%. Ability duration increased by 100%.
Dragonbreath: Base damage increased by 125%. Ability duration increased by 100%.
Lancer: Ability duration reduced by 75%.
Impulse: Base damage reduced by 20%. Ability duration increased by 200%.
The Defender Class.
Triad becomes Pentad: Deploys 5 barriers instead of 3. The ability also uses 55% less energy when the Barrier is not dealing damage or not taking damage.
Efficiency Perk: The ability uses 15% less energy when the Barrier is not dealing damage or not taking damage. 4 perk upgrade levels, each +15%.
The Medic Class.
Trauma Center: By default, ability energy regenerates only from enemy kills. Can be changed with the Wizardry perk. Ability duration reduced by 50%.
Emergency Aid: By default, ability energy regenerates only from enemy kills. Can be changed with the Wizardry perk.
Wizardry Perk: Passive ability energy regeneration increased by 1% per second.
The Strike Class.
Shatterblast: Passive ability energy regeneration time increased 18x (20 seconds). Cluster explosion damage increased by 33%.
Sentinel: Projectile damage increased by 33%. Sentinel can now fire 25 shots (previously 7).

notes.title: 5. The system for displaying weapon pickups beams has been improved.

items.text: Each player on the team now sees a different color for weapon pickup beams on the map.
The color of beam corresponds to the rarity of the weapon in each player’s profile (progression).
Hellspawn could have remained invincible in the final stage of The Pit. (

The Defender Class - The Repulsor perk does not activate on all Roamers caught in the shield.
Two players cannot activate the terminals to open the container on Root of Evil (they could only do so if both pressed on the terminals at the same time).
Snare could remain idle for a period of time after spawning.
Two players with the Medic class and the Remote subclass could infinitely restore their abilities.

This Demo update focuses on stability improvements and some Quality of Life adjustments. We've addressed the reported issue of blurry images by setting the "Cinematic Ambiance" to disabled by default. Please report back if you continue to experience this problem.
Regarding the highly-requested FOV slider, we want to assure you we are actively working on this feature and plan to implement it as soon as possible.
We’re also working on adding a toggle ADS option.
QoL Improvements

The "Cinematic Ambiance" graphic setting is now disabled by default. This change addresses and resolves the "blurry image" problem experienced by some players. The setting can still be activated via the Graphics tab in the Menu.
The issue preventing the "ready" button from functioning during matchmaking when players remapped the default "C" key has been corrected.
The shader precreation process has been optimized for faster loading.
Stability and Crash Fixes
Fixed server crashes which ended the game for all players in a party.
Fixed a crash that could happen when a player was incapacitated.
Fixed a crash on leaving the game.
Fixed rare crashes on switching weapons in different situations.
Fixed a rare crash that could happen if the game was ended with a zombie on a vehicle.
Fixed a rare crash when using the Mortar.
We’ll keep monitoring your feedback, so make sure to let us know if you encounter bugs or crashes!
